<document id="plan-plus">
TheˆPlusˆplanˆPlusˆcostsˆ$5.00ˆaˆmonth.ˆIt'sˆbuiltˆforˆpeopleˆwhoˆuseˆtheirˆcardˆaˆlotˆawayˆfromˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆorˆspendˆsomeˆtimeˆabroad,ˆandˆitˆaddsˆCushionˆandˆaˆhigherˆsavingsˆrate.ˆ##ˆWhat'sˆincludedˆ-ˆ**Monthlyˆfee:**ˆ$5.00ˆ-ˆ**ATMs:**ˆfreeˆatˆBrookLinkˆATMs,ˆplusˆ3ˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawalsˆaˆmonth.ˆAfterˆthatˆit'sˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Foreignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆ1%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆ-ˆ**Cardˆreplacement:**ˆfreeˆ-ˆ**Expeditedˆcardˆshipping:**ˆ$25.00ˆ-ˆ**SavingsˆPockets:**ˆ2.00%ˆAPYˆ-ˆ**Cushion:**ˆfee-freeˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆonˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆ-ˆ**Dailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit:**ˆ$5,000ˆ-ˆ**DailyˆATMˆlimit:**ˆ$1,000ˆ##ˆGoodˆtoˆknowˆPlusˆincludesˆoutgoingˆinternationalˆwiresˆforˆ$35.00ˆeach.ˆYourˆcardˆisˆplastic,ˆlikeˆBasic.ˆUpgradeˆtoˆPremiumˆifˆyouˆwantˆtheˆmetalˆcard.ˆYouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆUpgradesˆstartˆrightˆaway.ˆDowngradesˆstartˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-lost-stolen-v2">
LostˆorˆstolenˆcardˆIfˆyourˆcardˆisˆlostˆorˆstolen,ˆyouˆcanˆdealˆwithˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆinˆaˆcoupleˆofˆminutes.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆcallˆus.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆ**Freezeˆtheˆcard.**ˆTapˆCardsˆandˆswitchˆFreezeˆcardˆon.ˆThisˆstopsˆnewˆpurchasesˆrightˆaway.ˆ2.ˆ**Reportˆit.**ˆIfˆyouˆcan'tˆfindˆit,ˆtapˆReportˆlostˆorˆstolen.ˆThisˆcancelsˆtheˆcardˆpermanently.ˆItˆcan'tˆbeˆundone.ˆ3.ˆ**Addˆaˆvirtualˆcard.**ˆYouˆcanˆcreateˆoneˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆuseˆitˆonlineˆandˆinˆmobileˆwalletsˆrightˆawayˆwhileˆtheˆreplacementˆships.ˆ4.ˆ**Orderˆaˆreplacement.**ˆPickˆstandardˆorˆexpeditedˆshipping.ˆReplacementˆandˆshippingˆfeesˆdependˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆ5.ˆ**Checkˆyourˆtransactions.**ˆDisputeˆanythingˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognize.ˆ##ˆDeliveryˆStandardˆshippingˆtakesˆ7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactionsˆYou'reˆnotˆresponsibleˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆyouˆreportˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆtheyˆfirstˆappearˆon.ˆIfˆyouˆfoundˆyourˆcardˆafterˆfreezingˆit,ˆjustˆunfreezeˆit.ˆNothingˆelseˆchanges.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="account-verification-time">
HowˆlongˆverificationˆtakesˆMostˆapplicationsˆareˆverifiedˆwithinˆ1ˆbusinessˆday,ˆandˆmanyˆwithinˆminutes.ˆ##ˆManualˆreviewˆIfˆweˆneedˆtoˆcheckˆsomethingˆbyˆhand,ˆitˆcanˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ5ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆWeˆmayˆaskˆforˆanotherˆdocument,ˆsuchˆasˆproofˆofˆaddress.ˆ##ˆWhileˆyouˆwaitˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆdepositsˆintoˆyourˆnewˆaccount,ˆbutˆyouˆcan'tˆsendˆmoney,ˆwithdrawˆcashˆorˆorderˆaˆcardˆuntilˆyou'reˆverified.ˆ##ˆCheckingˆstatusˆTheˆappˆshowsˆyourˆverificationˆstatusˆonˆtheˆhomeˆscreen.ˆWe'llˆnotifyˆyouˆasˆsoonˆasˆit'sˆdone.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆspeedˆitˆup?ˆNo.ˆVerificationˆisˆhandledˆbyˆourˆVerificationˆteam,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆapproveˆapplicationsˆorˆtellˆyouˆmoreˆthanˆtheˆappˆshows.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆanythingˆfromˆyou,ˆwe'llˆaskˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆCommonˆcausesˆofˆdelaysˆAˆblurryˆIDˆphoto,ˆaˆnameˆthatˆdoesn'tˆmatchˆyourˆIDˆexactly,ˆorˆaˆrecentˆmoveˆareˆtheˆmostˆcommonˆreasonsˆweˆneedˆaˆmanualˆreview.ˆCheckingˆtheseˆbeforeˆyouˆapplyˆhelps.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
